fields.character_role: Protector - Police officer protecting people from hidden threats
fields.attr_vapen1_specialregler: Base damage 2 + Heavy Rune 1. Concealable; Light; two-handed. Rune uses both slots.
fields.armor1_details: Base 1 + rune 1. Additional +1 armor against Piercing; 3 rune slots.
fields.equipment3: Protective Ring, Physical: Second ring; armor value 2.
fields.ability1_cost: Action; 2 Mana; scene / up to 10 min
fields.ability1_effect: Choose one element at activation. Fire: +1 Fire melee damage and +1d6 for strength/endurance. Water: hold breath 10 minutes, move freely in water, +1d6 for agility/balance. Earth: +2 armor; cannot be made Prone or Restrained by physical forces. Air: +5 m movement and +1d6 for stealth/acrobatics/evasion. Electricity: an action may paralyze a target for 1 round (their Strength + Wisdom opposed by your Intelligence + Occult); +1d6 for fast reactions. Only one element at a time. Ends if Paralyzed, Asleep or unconscious. Cannot be active with Chi. GM confirms element eligibility.
fields.ability2_cost: Ally within 2 m is being attacked
fields.ability2_effect: Swap places with the ally who is being attacked, putting yourself in the danger. Coordinate with your team and stay close enough to intervene.
fields.ability3_cost: Starting type: Slashing; reaction to change: 1 Mana
fields.ability3_effect: Gain Resistance to the chosen damage type: roll an extra d6 and subtract it from damage of that type. Spend 1 Mana as a reaction to change to another damage type.
fields.background:
Since childhood, Maria had been the one who stood up to schoolyard bullies. Her determination to protect the vulnerable and follow the rules made a career in the police a natural choice.

Then came the case that could not be explained. The investigation concluded that the victim had died in an animal attack, but Maria had seen the body. She refused to accept the explanation and kept digging, drawing on contacts she neither should have used nor trusted.

Eventually, she came face to face with the beast. She opened fire, but her bullets had no effect. She would have died if GDA agents had not intervened. Their commanding officer had been following her investigation, allowing her to continue to see whether she had what it took. When they offered her the chance to protect people from threats the police could not handle, she accepted.

GOAL: Protect civilians from paranormal threats and discover how far the GDA's influence reaches behind the scenes.

WEAKNESS: Maria tends to see the world in black and white. Her rigid principles make it difficult for her to accept ambiguity and compromise.
fields.campaign_notes:
PLAYING ADVICE
Be where you are needed: Invest in movement abilities and Bodyguard so you can get between a threat and someone who needs protection.

Stay on your feet: Prioritise abilities and equipment that help you survive when things go wrong.

Draw the threat towards you: Use your position and actions to make enemies focus on you, giving more vulnerable teammates room to act.

NEXT STEPS
Resist starts with Slashing selected. Spend 1 Mana as a reaction to change its damage type. Earth Ki is a useful defensive choice; Air Ki helps positioning. There is no automatic taunt ability: draw attention through positioning and actions agreed with the GM.

BETA / GM NOTES
Ki requires a discipline tied to the chosen element. Maria's printed class lists Occult (Spirits); the GM should confirm which elements it supports. The class lists several armor-granting items without a clear stacking rule. Their individual values are recorded; no combined armor total is assumed.

The complete prebuilt class equipment is retained. Carrying-slot accounting and any beta exceptions should be agreed with the GM. No spare equipment points or bonus XP have been added.
